title: Pure Winged Dragon of Ra
summary: Marik Ishtar's Winged Dragon of Ra archetype revolves around the three forms of the Sun God—The Winged Dragon of Ra, The Winged Dragon of Ra - Sphere Mode, and The Winged Dragon of Ra - Immortal Phoenix—unified by The True Sun God and Ancient Chant! Activate The True Sun God to search Ancient Chant (or send Immortal Phoenix from your Deck to the GY with Guardian Slime + The True Sun God). Activate Ancient Chant to search The Winged Dragon of Ra, gain an extra Tribute Summon, and banish Ancient Chant from your GY so Ra gains the combined original ATK/DEF of its Tributes (such as a 3000 ATK/DEF Egyptian God Slime!) BEFORE you even pay your LP to boost Ra to 7,000–10,900 ATK! Equip Ra with Blaze Cannon to make it completely unaffected by your opponent's card effects and wipe their board after attacking, or send Ra from the field to the GY with Sun God Unification to gain LP equal to Ra's massive ATK and immediately awaken the 4000 ATK untargetable, unaffected Immortal Phoenix from your GY!

allow.Metal Reflect Slime: Continuous Trap Monster Set from your Deck by Reactor Slime (and searched if sent to GY) that transforms into the 3000 ATK / 3000 DEF Egyptian God Slime (giving Ra +3000 base ATK/DEF via Ancient Chant!).
allow.Foolish Burial: Limited to 1 in TCG: sends 'The Winged Dragon of Ra - Immortal Phoenix' directly from your Deck to the GY.
allow.Superdreadnought Rail Cannon Gustav Max: Rank 10 Xyz summoned in Main Phase 2 using Level 10 Egyptian God Slime + Level 10 The Winged Dragon of Ra or Immortal Phoenix to inflict 2000 burn damage for game.

main: The Winged Dragon of Ra

Marik's iconic Level 10 DIVINE Divine-Beast boss (? ATK / ? DEF): when Normal Summoned, cards and effects cannot be activated, and you can pay LP until you have 100 LP left to gain that much ATK/DEF (plus the original ATK/DEF of its Tributes via Ancient Chant!); and pays 1000 LP (as many times per turn as you have LP!) to target 1 monster on the field and destroy it!
The Winged Dragon of Ra - Sphere Mode

Level 10 DIVINE Divine-Beast board-breaker (0 ATK / 0 DEF): can be Normal Summoned to your opponent's field by Tributing 3 monsters they control, then returns control to you on the next turn; cannot be targeted for attacks or card effects; and tributes itself to Special Summon 'The Winged Dragon of Ra' from your hand or Deck with 4000 ATK and 4000 DEF!
The Winged Dragon of Ra - Immortal Phoenix

Level 10 DIVINE Divine-Beast boss (4000 ATK / 4000 DEF): if 'The Winged Dragon of Ra' is sent from the field to your GY while this card is in your GY (such as by The True Sun God or Sun God Unification!), immediately Special Summons itself; is completely UNAFFECTED by other cards' effects; pays 1000 LP to send 1 monster on the field to the GY WITHOUT targeting or destroying; and floats into Sphere Mode in the End Phase!
Guardian Slime

Core Level 10 WATER Aqua engine (0 ATK / 0 DEF): Special Summons itself from your hand when you take battle or effect damage; transforms on field into Egyptian God Slime; AND if sent from your hand or field to the GY, adds ANY Spell/Trap that mentions 'The Winged Dragon of Ra' ('The True Sun God', 'Ancient Chant', 'Soul Crossing', or 'Millennium Revelation'!) from your Deck to your hand!
Reactor Slime

Level 4 WATER Aqua starter: Special Summons 2 Slime Tokens during your Main Phase, and tributes itself during the Battle Phase to Set Metal Reflect Slime directly from your hand, Deck, or GY so it can be activated this turn.
The True Sun God

Core Continuous Spell: when activated, adds 'The Winged Dragon of Ra' OR any card that mentions it (except itself—searching Ancient Chant, Guardian Slime, Immortal Phoenix, or Sphere Mode!) from your Deck to your hand; prevents Special Summoned monsters (except Ra) from attacking the turn they are Special Summoned; and once per turn sends 'The Winged Dragon of Ra - Immortal Phoenix' from your Deck to the GY to send a face-up Ra you control to the GY (immediately triggering Immortal Phoenix to revive itself!)!
Ancient Chant

Core Normal Spell: adds 'The Winged Dragon of Ra' from your Deck or GY to your hand, and during your Main Phase this turn, you can Tribute Summon 1 monster in addition to your Normal Summon/Set; banishes itself from your GY so that when you Tribute Summon Ra this turn, its original ATK and DEF become the combined original ATK/DEF of the monsters Tributed for it (giving Ra 3000 ATK/DEF when Tributing Egyptian God Slime BEFORE paying LP!)!
Soul Crossing

Quick-Play Spell: during the Main Phase, immediately Tribute Summons 1 Divine-Beast monster (The Winged Dragon of Ra or Sphere Mode!) by Tributing up to 3 monsters from EITHER field, including your opponent's monsters!
Blaze Cannon

Signature Quick-Play Spell: its activation and effect CANNOT be negated; targets 1 'The Winged Dragon of Ra' you control—until the end of this turn, it becomes unaffected by your opponent's card effects, can tribute other monsters to gain their original ATK when attacking, and sends all monsters your opponent controls to the GY after damage calculation!
Millennium Revelation

Continuous Spell: sends 1 Divine-Beast monster (like Immortal Phoenix or extra Ra!) from your hand to the GY to add 'Monster Reborn' from your Deck or GY to your hand; and sends itself from the Spell & Trap Zone to the GY to allow 'Monster Reborn' to Special Summon 'The Winged Dragon of Ra' from your GY this turn ignoring its summoning conditions!
Sun God Unification

Continuous Trap (searchable by The True Sun God and Guardian Slime!): if you control a card whose original name is 'The Winged Dragon of Ra', you can activate this card the turn it was Set; during the Main Phase (Quick Effect), pays LP so you have 100 left to give a Special Summoned Ra that much ATK/DEF, OR tributes 1 'The Winged Dragon of Ra' to gain LP equal to its ATK on the field (while triggering Immortal Phoenix in your GY!)!
Metal Reflect Slime
Set directly from your Deck by Reactor Slime; summons itself as a Level 10 WATER Aqua with 0 ATK / 3000 DEF to tribute for Egyptian God Slime.
Foolish Burial
Limited to 1 in TCG: sends 'The Winged Dragon of Ra - Immortal Phoenix' directly from your Deck to the GY.
extra: Signature Level 10 WATER Aqua Fusion boss (3000 ATK / 3000 DEF): Special Summoned from your Extra Deck by Tributing a Level 10 WATER Aqua with 0 ATK (Guardian Slime or Metal Reflect Slime); cannot be destroyed by battle, protects your other monsters from attacks and targeting, and counts as 1 OR 3 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of The Winged Dragon of Ra (granting Ra 3000 original ATK/DEF via Ancient Chant!)!
Rank 10 Xyz (summoned using two Level 10 monsters: Egyptian God Slime + Ra / Immortal Phoenix) that detaches 1 material to inflict 2000 burn damage.
